jobs.title: Research NP or PA, Division of Genetics and Genomics (40 hours)
jobs.summary: Research NP or PA, Division of Genetics and Genomics (40 hours) at Boston Children's Hospital. Setting: mixed settings.
jobs.description:
The Division of Genetics and Genomics conducts studies for children with life-threatening ultra-rare genetic conditions using cutting-edge, small-scale and Phase ½ genomic medicine clinical trials. This is an exciting opportunity to work within a multidisciplinary team furthering research and bringing new treatments to patients with rare genetic conditions. Ideal candidates are able to commit to this role for 2 years.
Key Responsibilities
• Assisting with the day-to-day operations under immediate supervision, including screening, consenting, monitoring research participants, perform clinical examinations and evaluating adverse events.
• Determine eligibility (inclusion/exclusion) criteria for clinical trials
• Conduct comprehensive patient assessments through history taking and physical examinations.
• Conduct study visits and evaluate and collect medical history and safety assessments
• Form and implement care plans in partnership with supervising physicians
• Evaluate and validate adverse event information, including intensity, causality, clinical significance, and seriousness
• Assist in source documentation, data entry into data collection systems, regulatory binders, and audit readiness
• Assist CRAs with IRB protocols and submissions, pre-IND and IND documents and regulatory compliance
• Order and interpret diagnostic studies including labs, imaging and pathology; communicate results and next steps to care team and patients.
Perform basic procedures like skin biopsy and venipuncture.
• May participate in drug administration procedures like lumbar puncture or intravenous infusions when applicable, with guidance and supervision.
• Provide patient and family education including but not limited to diagnoses, treatment plans, and medications, and aftercare instructions using institution approved resources.
• Maintain accurate, timely, and complete documentation within the electronic medical record.
• Communicate with care teams within- and across- specialties, departments, as well as with outside institutions to facilitate care coordination across inpatient, outpatient, and emergency care settings.
• Support transitions of care, including discharge summaries, medication reconciliation, and handoffs between care teams.
• Complete prior authorizations, patient FMLA forms, letters of medical necessity, school/work notes, and respond to patient messages and phone calls.
• Participate in educational opportunities such as conferences, clinical rounds, journal clubs, case conferences, and institutional training sessions.
• Comply with all institutional safety protocols including infection control and compliance.
Minimum Qualifications
Education:
• Masters in Nursing or Physician Assistant Studies
Experience:
• Experience with human subject clinical trials strongly preferred
• If NP must have 1 year of RN/NP experience required, previous clinical NP experience preferred
• Knowledge about established and evolving biomedical and clinical sciences
